title: Finite invitation onboarding
scope: Create, deliver, list, resend, revoke, expire, and accept invitations.
Capture explicit viewer grant selection and bind acceptance to verified recipient identity.
Persist membership, grants, token consumption, audit, receipt, and outbox atomically as applicable.
invariants: Raw token never appears in ordinary responses, logs, or audit.
An invitation cannot grant resources outside project entitlement.
Current entitlement and membership state are rechecked at acceptance.

acceptance.given: A verified recipient accepts a valid invitation
acceptance.then: one membership and only selected grants exist with accepted state and audit

acceptance.given: An existing viewer or manager accepts another invitation
acceptance.then: identity/membership are reused; existing manager role is not downgraded

acceptance.given: A token is submitted by another verified recipient
acceptance.then: recipient mismatch denies without revealing invitation state

acceptance.given: The token is expired, revoked, or previously used with a new key
acceptance.then: no new grants or audit transitions occur; verified recipient gets defined unavailable state

acceptance.given: Two acceptance requests race on the same token
acceptance.then: only one transition commits; matching retry uses receipt, other replay is rejected

acceptance.given: An entitlement is disabled after invitation issue
acceptance.then: state conflict and no partial membership/grant commit
invitation stays pending, delivery key is stable, bounded retries become visible
acceptance cannot silently reactivate them; manager action is required

acceptance.given: A verified invited recipient has no organization membership
acceptance.then: only intended organization/project/resource labels are returned without consuming the token; wrong, stale, expired, or unverified recipients cannot inspect it
acceptance.evidence: recipient_preview visibility and auth freshness tests

acceptance.given: A sender crashes after provider delivery before acknowledgement
acceptance.when: the lease expires and another worker retries
acceptance.then: a stale lease cannot finalize; duplicate delivery cannot duplicate acceptance or grants
acceptance.evidence: controlled outbox crash lease CAS test

acceptance.given: A message exhausts attempts or its retry deadline
acceptance.when: the delivery worker or an operator processes it
acceptance.then: terminal failure is visible; replay is reviewed, bounded and impossible after ciphertext purge or invitation expiry
acceptance.evidence: DLQ replay and purge integration tests

acceptance.given: An old invitation delivery remains pending
acceptance.when: resend or entitlement revocation invalidates the invitation
acceptance.then: worker rechecks current invitation before delivery; any racing delivered old token fails acceptance
acceptance.evidence: stale delivery and token lifecycle regression
